title: PD1180-EPR — NEMA 34 Smart Motor-Mounted Stepper Controller with USB-C PD 3.1 EPR

text: 01 / USB-C EPR Power and USB Data
J1 carries 48 V / 5 A EPR power and USB 2.0 device data on one USB-C receptacle.
U1: 48 V CC/VBUS and D+/D- protection. U2: TPS26750 EPR sink controller. U3: PD policy EEPROM. U4: hardware power-permit gate.
R107/R108/C72: 5-60 V attach sense. Q1: protected VBUS control. Q2/Q3: PD-path level translation.
Either USB or motor bus sustains 3.3 V; ideal diodes block reverse current.
U5: USB 5 V buck. U22: motor-bus auxiliary buck. U23/U24: ideal-diode OR into the shared 3.3 V rail.
Nominal eFuse limit 4.48 A. No reverse energy into the USB source.
Q4: reverse-blocking power MOSFET. Q5: fast gate clamp. U6: TPS26631 48 V eFuse, current monitor and fault output.
SPI-controlled TMC5160A. Driver remains disabled until the hardware enable chain is valid.
U7: motion controller and gate driver. U8/U9: Step/Dir limit multiplexers. U10/U11 + Q14/Q15: hardwired enable interlock.
Phase A target 5.5 A RMS; Kelvin sense routing and high-current copper require review.
Q6/Q8: high-side MOSFETs. Q7/Q9: low-side MOSFETs. R109: 33 mOhm, 3 W phase-current shunt.
Phase B target 5.5 A RMS; independent 33 milliohm sense resistor.
Q10/Q12: high-side MOSFETs. Q11/Q13: low-side MOSFETs. R110: 33 mOhm, 3 W phase-current shunt.
Nominal brake threshold 52.9 V; external resistor sizing depends on total stored mechanical energy.
U12: precision threshold reference. U13/U14: overvoltage comparators. U15: MOSFET gate driver. Q16: brake switch.
3.3 V STM32G0B1; USB data, SWD, SPI motion control and serial interfaces.
U16: system MCU with native USB, FDCAN and ADC monitoring. U17: 32 Mbit external SPI configuration/telemetry flash.
AS5047P is centered on the PCB underside; shaft magnet alignment must be verified.
U18: 14-bit magnetic shaft encoder; SPI readout plus ABI incremental outputs and local 3.3 V filtering.
External CAN/RS485 termination; J6 carries RS232, CAN and RS485.
U19: 3.3 V CAN transceiver; D2: CAN TVS. U20: RS485 transceiver; D3: RS485 TVS. U21: RS232 transceiver.
Non-isolated 24 V inputs. J7 consolidates home, stops, digital inputs and Step/Direction.
Q17-Q23: 24 V tolerant NPN input conditioners for HOME, limits, DIN0/1 and Step/Direction signals.
J9: motor rail, 24 V hardware enable, OUT0 and OUT1. External loads need rating review.
Q24/Q25: open-collector 24 V output drivers; base pulldowns keep outputs off during reset.
